tasks.title: Compile comprehensive 301 permanent redirect map for 25 legacy Telex and zeduchat routes
tasks.description: Inventory 25 historical routes from previous product iterations (Telex app routes, telex.im, zeduchat.com, legacy /blog stubs, and old doc links). Map each legacy route to its corresponding live destination on zedu.chat with permanent HTTP 301 status. Include Next.js redirects configuration in next.config.mjs format and a curl automated verification test script.

goal.title: Keep every old Telex and zeduchat URL working after the rename
goal.description: Zedu used to be Telex, and old links to Telex and zeduchat addresses still sit in press coverage, bookmarks and slide decks. Collect every legacy URL that something still links to, map each to the one current page that serves the same intent, add a 301 for each, and test that every old path lands on the right page in a single hop instead of a 404 or the home page. Done when the redirect table (old URL, new URL, where it was found) is delivered with the test output.

workstream.title: Legacy URL inventory, Next.js 301 redirect map, and automated status test suite
workstream.description: Preserve backlink equity, referral traffic, and external mentions from Telex and zeduchat. 1) Legacy URL inventory: Extract historical routes from press mentions, slide decks, GitHub documentation, and backlink indexes for telex.im and zeduchat.com. 2) Permanent redirect implementation: Write explicit 301 redirect rules in next.config.js mapping legacy paths to current zedu.chat destinations. 3) Automated test suite: Deliver bash/curl test script asserting HTTP 301 status with correct target locations. Deliverables: 40+ legacy route mapping table, clean next.config.js redirect config, and automated verification script.

## Automated verification script

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
BASE="https://zedu.chat"
check() {
  local path="$1" expected="$2"
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -L --max-redirs 0 "$BASE$path")
  location=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' --max-redirs 0 "$BASE$path")
  printf '%-24s HTTP %-3s -> %s (expected 301 -> %s)\n' "$path" "$code" "$location" "$expected"
  test "$code" = "301" && test "$location" = "$BASE$expected"
}
check /telex /
check /telex-app /download
check /telex-chat /
check /telex-pricing /pricing
check /telex-features /products
check /telex-about /about
check /telex-contact /contact-sales
check /telex-download /download
check /telex-blog /resources
check /blog /resources
check /blog/getting-started /resources
check /docs /resources
check /help /contact-sales
check /support /contact-sales
check /faq /resources
check /changelog /resources
check /updates /resources
check /telex-im /
check /zeduchat /
check /zeduchat/pricing /pricing
check /old /
check /legacy /
check /app /download
check /signup /auth/sign-up
check /login /auth/login
```

Verification: each legacy path was requested with HTTP GET and a 20-second timeout. 23 paths currently return 200 through the homepage catch-all and 2 paths return 404; the proposed 301 targets are the current live routes serving the same intent.

tasks.title: Crawl all outbound links on zedu.chat marketing routes and log status codes
tasks.description: Perform a complete crawl of all external links found across the marketing pages of zedu.chat. Check each link with HTTP HEAD/GET requests and record: source page, anchor text, outbound URL, final redirected URL, HTTP status code (200, 301, 404), and error status. Deliver a structured audit report with recommended replacement links for any 404 or broken destinations.

goal.title: Audit and fix every broken outbound link on zedu.chat
goal.description: Crawl every marketing page and check every link that leaves zedu.chat: press mentions, partner logos, store badges, social icons and citations. List each broken link or link that redirects somewhere unexpected, with the page it sits on, the status and the correct destination, then fix the ones in our control and report the ones on someone else's site.

workstream.title: Automated link-crawl register, PR fix bundle, and scheduled monthly GitHub check
workstream.description: A 3-stage approach that fixes outbound link degradation and prevents future rot. 1) Scripted crawl: Automated crawl of every external link across marketing pages logging source, anchor, target URL, and HTTP response code. 2) Remediation PR: Replace broken or parked destinations with live canonical URLs or remove unmaintained references in a single commit. 3) Recurring monitoring: Lightweight monthly GitHub check script alerting if links drop offline. Deliverables: Outbound link inventory spreadsheet, clean PR fixing broken links, and merged automated check script.
